Title: 498648-2026: Italy – Construction work for school buildings or research establishments – COMPLETION OF THE RENOVATION AND EXTENSION WORKS OF THE SECOND PHASE OF THE FORMER VASCA NAVALE IN ROME, VIA DELLA VASCA NAVALE

titel: Completion of the renovation and extension works of the second construction phase of the former ship testing facility in Rome, Via della Vasca Navale
kurzbeschreibung: Renovation and extension of a university building on the site of the former ship testing facility in Rome.
umfang: Construction works for the renovation and extension of the second construction phase of the former Vasca Navale for university uses; no information on GFA, spans, number of storeys or structure in the contract notice text.
leistungen: Construction works for the renovation and extension of a university or research building; no planning services or HOAI service phases mentioned.
relevanzbewertung_erklaerung:
• University buildings can in principle be of interest, especially for larger or complex buildings.
• Here, however, only a construction tender has been published, without explicit reference to planning or structural design services.
• There is no information on the structure, spans, architectural distinctiveness or structural complexity.
• The project volume is high, but strategically only of limited relevance for sbp, as no engineering or checking services are being tendered.
• Therefore, low to medium relevance.
baukosten_erklaerung: Taken from the tender; the estimated contract value excluding VAT is stated, not explicitly cost groups 300/400.
honorar_erklaerung: No fee for sbp can be derived, as only construction works are being tendered and no planning services with remuneration are mentioned.
referenzen_qualifikationen: Suitability criteria and selection criteria according to the tender documents; no specific reference requirements stated in the contract notice itself.
zuschlagskriterien: Quality; weighting not stated in the contract notice.
auftraggeber: Università degli Studi Roma Tre, 00154 Rome, Italy, contact: Raffaella Piaggesi, e-mail: raffaella.piaggesi@uniroma3.it, telephone: 0657332624, website/procurement platform: https://uniroma3.traspare.com
notes: Open procedure for construction works. Estimated contract duration 1267 days. Deadline for additional information: 11.09.2026, 12:00. Tender opening: 21.09.2026, 12:30. Contract notice is published in Italian. No technical building data included in the TED text.
